prompt: Create an exquisite occult fantasy artifact surface for the FRONT backing of a collectible card. Portrait 2:3, straight-on orthographic, full bleed. This is an ORIGINAL artistic interpretation inspired by a slate formed from the remains of a primordial divine being, holding knowledge older than human language. It must read as an unnerving sacred relic, NOT an architectural stone sample. Material: deep ash-gray to pale ivory-gray petrified divine substance, satin mineral skin with restrained translucent subsurface depth, as if ancient knowledge is embedded at several depths within it. Fine dark incised script-like forms emerge FROM the substance itself, not printed onto it: a sophisticated sparse palimpsest of unknown primordial calligraphic marks, interlinked line structures and partially submerged inscriptions, ordered but impossible to fully decipher. These are invented nonliteral marks, NOT readable real-world text, not a copied alphabet. The peripheral third contains the most visible fine etching and layered occult relief; the central field retains extremely faint latent inscriptions and deep mist-like mineral strata, quiet enough for later character illustration but not blank or dead. Upper center must remain calm to receive a separate small emblem. Convey simultaneous sacred serenity and uncanny wrongness, ancient wear alongside impossibly pristine submerged structures. Tiny restrained bone-white and aged pale-gold glimmers come from within a few incisions, never neon, never a central spotlight. Low saturation, luminous ash and muted charcoal recesses, subtle directional light from upper left, coherent exquisite sculptural detail, restrained chiaroscuro. It should look like forbidden knowledge fossilized into a beautiful divine relic. The surface fills the entire canvas; no separate slab silhouette, no bevel border, no external surroundings, no perspective, no frame, no metal rails, no emblem, no numeral, no central medallion, no sun disk, no character, no faces, no skulls, no gore, no tentacles, no large fractures, no generic concentric magic circles, no wallpaper of repeated runes, no gold filigree border. Leave actual frame and contact shadows to later composition. Prioritize a singular refined occult material identity over random grit, sand, concrete, marble veins or distressed paper.

spec.material: 神骸凝成、知识内生的亵渎石板意象；原创非字面美术转译，隐现铭文与内部层次一体
spec.lighting: 左上柔光与极克制刻痕内光；无中心强光；接触阴影独立合成
